title: Flying craft through the mind for a brain neural interface
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: >> These UAP, UFO, other materials. They're not flown with joysticks. They're flown through the mind.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose says that as a child, around 2008 to 2010, he was taken into a secret UFO programme at a place called Baker Victory Services in Western New York. He says the work involved linking a brain to a machine, because unidentified craft, which he calls UAP (the government's term for unidentified anomalous phenomena) and UFOs, are not flown with joysticks but through the mind. If true, it would mean children were used to learn how to pilot such craft.
